name: kriti.app
tagline: The largest free Bangla font catalog, with a CDN and an API.
summary: Browse 315+ open-license Bangla fonts, test them with live previews, and use them anywhere via a WOFF2 CDN, a REST API, or one-line PowerShell & Bash installers.
overview: Finding Bangla fonts you are actually allowed to use has always meant digging through forums and mirror sites. kriti.app collects fonts released under OFL, Creative Commons and GPL licenses in one catalog, credits each font's original author, and lets you try every one with your own text before downloading.

Kriti is also infrastructure: every font is served from a WOFF2 CDN, so a website can load Bangla typography with a single stylesheet link, and the catalog is exposed through a REST API. The same catalog powers the Kriti Windows app, the WordPress plugin, and the Firefox add-on.

name: Vertical Extension of a Civil Engineering Building
tagline: B.Sc. thesis: a 7-storey steel extension over a 1968 RCC building, without touching it.
summary: Design of a structurally independent composite steel extension that turns a working 3-storey RCC building into a 10-storey one, per BNBC 2020 (LRFD).

facts.label: Supervisor
facts.value: Dr. Muhammad Abdur Rahman Bhuiyan, CUET

overview: The Civil Engineering building at CUET is a three-storey RCC structure from 1968 that is in constant use. The brief: add seven storeys without retrofitting, loading, or interrupting the original building.

The solution is a structurally independent composite steel frame. New columns rise through open interior spaces and along the perimeter, bypassing the old structure entirely and carrying all vertical and lateral loads down to a new mat foundation.

The design follows LRFD per BNBC 2020, with dead, live, wind and seismic combinations analysed in ETABS 2018, connections checked in IDEA StatiCa, and drawings in AutoCAD. A seismic evaluation of the combined ten-storey building used the BSPP Seismic Evaluation Manual (PWD, Bangladesh) and confirmed it meets current standards.

features.text: New steel columns bypass the RCC frame to a dedicated mat foundation.
